## Terms

### time series collection

- **time series collection** · self — Time series collections use [zstd](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/glossary.md#std-term-zstd) compression, which differs from the global default compression algorithm, [snappy.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/glossary.md#std-term-snappy) · aka: time series collections, time-series collection, time-series collections, timeseries, time series, time-series, timeseries collection — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-compression.md#default-compression-algorithm

### block processing

- **block processing** · part — Block processing is automatic. Users cannot enable or disable it for a single query. Eligibility is decided per query, and queries with unsupported operators or expressions run on the classic engine. SBE support is version specific and still changing. · aka: block processing, block-based processing, Block Processing, vectorized, columnar execution — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.2/core/timeseries/timeseries-querying/

### time series query

- **time series query** · part · aka: $match on timeField, range query on timeField, time range query, $group by time, $dateTrunc, downsampling, last point, last point query, most recent measurement, $sort on timeField, sort by time, bounded sort, $sort optimization, predicate pushdown, $match pushdown, timeseries query, querying a time series collection, aggregation on time series

### working set for time series

- **working set for time series** · measure · aka: working set, WiredTiger cache, memory footprint, storage size, compression, columnar compression, bucket size, bucket count, timeseriesBucketMaxCount, timeseriesBucketMaxSize, compaction, sizing, capacity

### time series sharding

- **time series sharding** · related · aka: shard a time series collection, sharded time series, shard key for time series, meta field shard key

### index

- **index** · related — If an index uses prefix compression (which is the [`default for WiredTiger`](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/program/mongod.md#std-option-mongod.--wiredTigerIndexPrefixCompression)), the returned size reflects the compressed size. · aka: indexes, indexed, IXSCAN, COLLSCAN, explain, executionStats — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.totalIndexSize.md#definition
